inputs.text: This is how institutions manage dissent: first NBC turns “F*** Joe Biden!” into “Let’s go Brandon!”, then schools and courts decide even the cleaned-up version is too dangerous to wear. The two Michigan brothers taking their case to the U.S. Supreme Court are exposing the real issue: officials get to decide which political messages are acceptable, and “protecting students” becomes the convenient excuse for silencing the ones they can’t control.

output.main_topic: Claims that institutions suppress political dissent through restrictions on protest messages
subtopics: Restrictions on clothing messages at schools and courts
A case before the U.S. Supreme Court
